episodes.title: Prometheus Bound
episodes.break_rationale: Concludes as Oppenheimer accepts the Manhattan Project mandate from General Groves; natural thematic transition to Los Alamos mesa.
episodes.recap_text: J. Robert Oppenheimer navigates European quantum physics breakthroughs, returns to UC Berkeley, and joins General Groves to head secret atomic research.
episodes.teaser_next: A remote desert mesa in New Mexico becomes the focal point of the secret atomic laboratory.

episodes.title: The Secret City
episodes.break_rationale: Ends on the eve of the Trinity test countdown as weather worsens; maximum suspense pause.
episodes.recap_text: Scientists gather at Los Alamos amidst rising logistical hurdles while military intelligence investigates Oppenheimer's ties to Jean Tatlock.
episodes.teaser_next: Zero hour arrives in the Jornada del Muerto desert as storm clouds gather over the 100-foot steel tower.

episodes.title: Trinity
episodes.break_rationale: Concludes with the fateful silent detonation shockwave and its horrifying geopolitical fallout.
episodes.recap_text: The gadget is successfully detonated in the desert, but Oppenheimer's triumph is quickly replaced by dread over Hiroshima, Nagasaki, and the escalating arms race.
episodes.teaser_next: Post-war Washington turns hostile as Lewis Strauss initiates a covert campaign to revoke Oppenheimer's security clearance.

episodes.title: The Chain Reaction
episodes.break_rationale: The miniseries concludes with Strauss's Senate humiliation and the haunting pond revelation between Oppenheimer and Einstein.
episodes.recap_text: Oppenheimer endures the kangaroo court of the AEC Gray Board while Strauss's Cabinet nomination collapses in the US Senate.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the epic historical miniseries.
